shared_elements: rows of repeated signs or symbols
linear outline relief with schematic internal details
justification: The strongest correspondence is the use of profile birds and other schematic signs arranged in horizontal, register-like rows on an upright decorated surface. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a central scene of two human figures in a ritual/interactional relationship with inscriptions below and around them, whereas B is dominated by stacked animal and abstract motifs without the same human encounter or object relationships.
